dashboard.historyHint: One point is recorded per day while you use the app.
dashboard.missing_one: {{count}} holding is excluded: price or exchange rate missing.
dashboard.missing_other: {{count}} holdings are excluded: prices or exchange rates missing.
dashboard.emptyBody: Add your banks and brokers, then the stocks, cash and gold you hold in each. Your data never leaves this device.
dashboard.refreshErrors: Some prices could not be updated:

assets.selectionHint: Select assets or accounts to narrow the total.

institutions.empty: No accounts yet. Add your first bank or broker.

history.empty: No history yet. A snapshot of every account and holding is saved once a day while you use the app.
history.needMore: The chart appears once there are at least two days of history.
history.note: A snapshot is saved on each day you open or change the app. Days you don't use it are skipped.
history.noChanges: No positions were added, removed or changed in size.
history.noDetail: This day was recorded before detailed history was available, so only the total is shown.
history.notFound: No snapshot was recorded for this day.
history.assetsEmpty: Assets appear here once a detailed daily snapshot has been recorded.
history.assetNotFound: No history has been recorded for this asset yet.

forms.symbolHint: Ticker for price lookups, e.g. AAPL, THYAO.IS, BTC
forms.autoHint: Updated online once a day and when you pull to refresh.
forms.fallbackPriceHint: Used until the first online price arrives, or if fetching fails.
forms.symbolRequired: Enter a symbol, or switch the price to Manual.
forms.derivedGoldHint: Calculated from the gold spot price and the unit's pure gold content.
forms.deleteAssetMsg_one: This also deletes {{count}} holding of it.
forms.deleteAssetMsg_other: This also deletes {{count}} holdings of it.

search.noMatches: No matches. You can still type the symbol yourself.
search.failed: Search is unavailable right now. You can still type the symbol yourself.
search.pickHint: Fills in the name, symbol and current price
search.priceFailed: Couldn't fetch the current price. It will be retried when you save.

settings.appLockHint: Require Face ID, fingerprint or device passcode to open the app.
settings.fetchPrivacy: Prices update once a day and when you add an asset. Ticker symbols, currency codes and what you type into asset search are sent directly from this device to Yahoo Finance, Frankfurter (ECB rates) and CoinGecko — plus Finnhub if you add a key. Your holdings, amounts and accounts are never sent. Turn this off to keep the app fully offline.
settings.finnhubHint: Optional fallback for US stocks. Stored only on this device.
settings.loadDemoConfirm: This replaces all your current data with a sample portfolio.
settings.deleteAllConfirm: All accounts, assets and history will be permanently erased from this device. Make a backup first if you want to keep them.
settings.aboutText: Net Worth is open-source software (MIT). It has no servers, accounts, ads or analytics. Data is encrypted on this device with a key kept in the system keychain.

rates.fxHint: Units per 1 USD. A manual value overrides the fetched one.
rates.gramHint: Manual price for 1 gram of 24k gold. Overrides the fetched spot price.

backup.intro: Backups are encrypted with a password you choose. Keep the password safe — it cannot be recovered.
backup.importConfirm: Restoring replaces everything currently in the app.
backup.invalidFile: This file is not a valid backup.

lock.title: Net Worth is locked
lock.noAuth: Set up a device passcode or biometrics to use the app lock.

errors.loadBody: If the encryption key was lost (for example after moving to a new phone), the data can't be decrypted. You can reset the app and restore a backup.
